name: Popeye audio output stage
drawing: TPP2-CPU schematic, sheet 2 of 3, in the Popeye operation manual (doc a4dc252b9a5e, p. 35) -- via MAME's netlist, compared with it and corrected
revision: Popeye CPU board TPP2-CPU, audio: the AY-3-8910's three channels filtered and mixed, and the two-transistor output stage to the TV's audio.
coverage: 0 ICs, 23 other parts and 14 nets over 48 pins. Converted from MAME's netlist: the AY-3-8910's filters, mixer and output stage. The AY is a MAME device; its outputs are ports. It has no ICs, so there is no board view: the netlist and the bill of materials carry it.

origin.sourceLabel: The conversion, every change from MAME's file logged
origin.what: The netlist is MAME's -- written to simulate this board, from its schematics -- converted here into the board's own nets, with MAME's simulation stand-ins undone and, where this site holds the schematic, checked and corrected against it. The board view, chip lookup and bill of materials are made from it.
